## Reverting a manifest change from v1.4.2 that made the NVS problem worse

v1.4.2 fixed the flasher writing a merged image whose padding overwrote NVS, but it also flipped a setting called `new_install_prompt_erase` to `false` on the theory that `false` meant "don't erase." It doesn't. In ESP Web Tools, that flag controls whether you're **asked** before an erase — set to `false`, it skips the question and erases the whole chip automatically on any install that isn't byte-identical to what's already on the device. Set to `true`, it shows a confirmation with an unchecked-by-default checkbox, so a plain install doesn't erase anything unless you deliberately check the box. `true` was the correct value the whole time; this release puts it back.

If you flashed v1.4.2, your settings were wiped by this, not by the bug v1.4.2 fixed — that part is confirmed working, and this release doesn't touch it.

### The actually-useful part
- **Fixed**: `new_install_prompt_erase` restored to `true` on all three manifests — v1.4.2 had flipped it to `false`, which skips ESP Web Tools' confirmation and erases the whole chip on every install instead of preventing erasure
